transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Robert, we're happy with our current service. But we're opening four new distribution centers this year and need to plan our network infrastructure.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's fantastic growth! Four new centers is significant expansion. Are you looking to replicate your current setup or enhance capabilities?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We want to standardize on higher bandwidth and add redundancy. Also considering SD-WAN to connect everything seamlessly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect timing. Our SD-WAN solution would connect all locations with centralized management. For four new sites plus upgrading existing, we're looking at significant infrastructure enhancement.
